title: Restriction of internal inhomogeneous bar cochains
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative condensed ring, $F$ an internal-function presentation, $K,J$ profinite groups and $v:K\to J$ a continuous homomorphism. Let $B_J,B_K$ be any given bar diagrams [def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data], with cochain conventions [def-sfb-internal-cochain-coordinate-data]. There is a coefficient-natural cochain map $r:C_{B_J}\to \operatorname{inflate}_v C_{B_K}$ whose evaluation on every profinite slice (T,f) and every tuple g is evaluation of the original cochain on the tuple v(g). Inflation uses the given restricted action. No homogeneous presentation, coordinate square or derived-category comparison is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0DVG, section-continuous-group-cohomology, displayed bar differential. Internal sheaf adaptation of the coordinate calculation, written by an agent; not asserted verbatim by Stacks.

proof.text: Precompose every evaluation family by the map on tuples induced by v. This preserves naturality under base change and all linear operations. The evaluation equivalence and section-module equivalence give internal degreewise maps, conjugated by the two given bar-term isomorphisms. The map law for evaluation and naturality of the bar terms give naturality in all equivariant coefficient maps.

proof.text: Precomposition commutes with every bar face. The first face uses the inflated action v(g_0), each interior face uses v(ab)=v(a)v(b), and the last face simply drops an entry. Consequently precomposition commutes with the signed sum of the face maps, proving the cochain identity. The construction gives the required evaluation over every profinite slice, including the empty tuple and empty test objects.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_internalBarRestrictionEvaluation {A : Ring.{u}} (F : InternalFunctions A)
    (K J : ProfiniteGrp.{u}) (v : K →ₜ* J)
    (BJ : BarDiagram (G := J) F) (BK : BarDiagram (G := K) F) :
    ∃ r : cochains BJ ⟶ Profinite.CondensedAction.inflate v ⋙ cochains BK,
      ∀ (M : Equivariant A J) (n : ℕ) (S : Profinite.{u})
        (x : sections A (((cochains BJ).obj M).X n) S)
        (T : Profinite.{u}) (f : T ⟶ S) (g : Fin n → C(T, K)),
        inhomogeneousCoordinateValue BK ((Profinite.CondensedAction.inflate v).obj M)
            n S (((r.app M).f n).hom.hom.app (op S) x) T f g =
          inhomogeneousCoordinateValue BJ M n S x T f
            (fun i ↦ v.toContinuousMap.comp (g i))
